Instead of carving a real pumpkin, many stores sell relatively cheap soft plastic/hard foam pumpkins you can carve and save. You can make spiders from pipe cleaners and foam craft balls.

Remember those cheap pumpkin baskets, the round plastic ones with the black strap? Cut hole on bottom, change porch light with green bulbs, place on top. Looks pretty cool.

I did some ghosts for Halloween. Fun to make with kids.

Items needed: White cloth, string or thread, markers, and cotton balls.

Instructions:

  1. Grab a handful of cotton balls and put them on the center of a white cloth
  2. Wrap the cloth around the cotton balls and form a 'head'
  3. Tie the 'neck' with string. Leave enough string so it can be hung

  4. Draw on face with a marker

  5. Optional: Make hats or accessories.

And done! Just hang it wherever you want.

PS: For best results, hang the ghost from the top of the head. It droops if you hang it from the neck. In the image above, I used a needle to run a thread through the top of the head and made a knot inside the head to stop the thread and hold the head.

All the cheap stores have reasonably priced decorations if you don't have the time to make your own, like the pumpkin printed garbage bags you put leaves in, little plastic witches on sticks etc etc
